concept_definition.trigger: A teammate uploads a file or requests access to a shared file.
concept_definition.outcome: A permitted teammate collects a prepared download; the uploader can revoke a recipient grant.

concept_definition.meaning: Store an uploaded file under its uploader identity.
The uploader grants a named teammate access.
The uploader or an active recipient views a visible file.
Check current file access at submission, persist the authorized task, and enqueue background preparation.
Prepare an accepted task using its recorded submission authorization. Later grant revocation does not cancel it.
The requester collects a ready task authorized at submission. Current recipient-grant revocation does not reject this accepted task.
The uploader revokes one recipient grant, preventing new download tasks while preserving existing accepted tasks.

concept_definition.trigger: A logged-in teammate opens the board, or a designated editor publishes or changes their own announcement.
concept_definition.outcome: Teammates read announcements; designated editors author their own content without gaining file authority.

concept_definition.meaning: An independent bulletin board; editor authority does not grant file access.
Logged-in teammates read the independent bulletin board.
A designated announcement editor creates an announcement as its author.
A designated editor changes an announcement they authored.
A designated editor deletes an announcement they authored.

concept_definition.trigger: A preset teammate submits a username and password.
concept_definition.outcome: Only verified credentials establish an authenticated session. No registration or account-management pages.

concept_definition.meaning: Verify the preset account password and establish an authenticated session; selecting an account name alone does not authenticate.
